_comment: Facade styles for the OSM scene builder's LOD3 and for upgrading an
existing scene to LOD3 (pages/osm_scene/facades.py). Every length is in
metres. A style is a building typology read off photographs of real
streets, not a decoration theme: what matters for the ray tracer is
where the glass, the metal and the edges are.
floor_height / ground_floor_height -- storey heights; the ground floor
of a street-facing wall is taller and carries the shop windows.
window_width/height/pitch, lintel (window top to the next floor line),
corner_pier (solid wall kept at each end of a facade), recess (depth
of the reveal: 0.3 in old brick, ~0.1 in panels, 0 in curtain walls).
frame: 'metal' | 'wood' | 'none' -- window frames and mullions as
solid bars; mullions = vertical bars inside a window, transom = one
horizontal bar at two thirds of its height.
surround (protrusion of the window surround), pilaster_every (bays
between pilasters, 0 = none), string_course (depth of the band at
every floor line), plinth_height/depth, cornice_height/projection
(the top trim), parapet_height/thickness (flat roofs only).
Cornice and parapet are written in the wall material so the roof
edge is a diffracting wedge -- a separate roof mesh never is one.
balconies: 'none' | 'columns' (stacked over each other, every
balcony_every-th bay, like on every Soviet and modern block),
balcony_depth, railing: 'metal' | 'wall'.
shopfront_fraction -- share of street-facing ground-floor bays that
are shop windows. entrance_spacing (m between entrances, 0 = none),
canopy: 'metal' | 'wall' | 'none', canopy_depth, steps.
stairwell_offset -- windows above an entrance sit on the stair
landings, half a storey off the rest (panel blocks).
blank_walls_shorter_than -- end walls of panel blocks carry no windows.
curtain_wall -- one glazed band per storey between spandrels, metal
mullions every mullion_spacing.

historic_lowrise.label: Historic low-rise (19th c.)
historic_lowrise.description: 2-4 storeys: tall windows with surrounds, pilasters, string courses, heavy cornice, shops on the ground floor (Kazan Bauman St., old European centres)

perimeter_block.label: Perimeter block (Stalinist / Haussmann)
perimeter_block.description: 5-8 storeys: regular tall windows, balconies in columns, rusticated plinth, cornice and parapet, porches with concrete canopies

soviet_panel.label: Soviet panel block (5-16 storeys)
soviet_panel.description: Khrushchyovka / panel: low storeys, near-flush windows, loggias and balconies in columns, blank end walls, stair windows half a storey off, parapet, metal porch canopies

modern_office.label: Modern office (curtain wall)
modern_office.description: Glass band per storey between spandrels, aluminium mullions every 1.5 m, glazed lobby at street level, parapet, deep metal entrance canopy

modern_residential.label: Modern residential tower
modern_residential.description: 17+ storeys or new build: wide windows in metal frames, deep balconies in columns, parapet, shops below

house.label: Detached house
house.description: 1-2 storeys: small windows with surrounds, porch with steps and a canopy, eaves trim

industrial.label: Industrial / warehouse
industrial.description: Tall storeys, ribbon windows high on the wall in metal frames, few doors, parapet
